test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word to fill in the blank.

Only Mr. Sen’s emotions were __genuine__, while others showed _______ sadness at grandmother’s death.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **fake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"genuine"** means something that is truly what it is said to be; authentic. (असली)

 
 
• **Example:** The painting is genuine, not a reproduction.
 
 
 
• **"Fake"** refers to something that is not genuine; it is an imitation or counterfeit. (नकली)
 
 
• **Example:** The handbag she bought was fake, not a real designer product.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym of 'genuine' is 'fake'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **fake**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Friendly** (मित्रवत): Characteristic of or befitting a friend; showing friendship.

 
 
• **Example:** He gave me a friendly smile as I entered the room.
 
 
 
• **Precise** (सटीक): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a precise description of the event.
 
 
 
• **Authentic** (प्रामाणिक): Of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine.
 
 
• **Example:** The document is authentic and has been verified by experts.
